_README: Breakthrough-seizure decision tables transcribed from Dr. Barbour's 2026-06-25 feedback; reconciled 2026-07-08 with revised breakthrough-nonurgent/urgent/emergent_decision_tables xlsx (breakthrough-nonurgent/urgent/emergent_decision_tables.xlsx). verified:true - the cells are her breakthrough workbooks. The engine consults this for BREAKTHROUGH patients ONLY when the 6-level side-effect scale captured a level (side_effect_level 0-5); legacy 3-level inputs keep the existing rules R5b-R13 (gold cases unaffected). Each cell: category (engine RecommendationCategory token), optional at_max_category (used when the medicine is already at the dose ceiling), pace, dosing (offer uneven/TID dosing switch), labs (order drug labs), urgent (add an urgent flag for physician), safety (withhold family message + urgent review), followup_weeks, and `steps` = the verbatim action list for the clinician. Multi-step dose instructions (e.g. 'end at +1 increase', 'make 1-2 increases') are surfaced as guidance; the engine does not compute the exact dose number (see NEEDS_PI_SIGNOFF).
